text_block_list.text:
Following the Tenno Sho (Autumn)... In 
order to keep running in the future, 
Silence Suzuka told her Trainer she would 
dedicate herself to treating her injury.

The Trainer, who had assumed she would 
keep running in races despite pushing 
herself, couldn't hide their surprise at 
her change of mindset.

Silence Suzuka places her trust in the 
Trainer, saying that she was able to run 
all the way to the end of the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) thanks to their supportive words.

Silence Suzuka tells the Trainer that she 
wants the two of them to keep watching the 
view from the front together.
